component.name: SignalPatch
component.summary: A guitar rig you patch with cables

description.p: Amps, cabinets, pedals, a looper, a 4-track, synths and voice effects as modules. Connect them with cables while the sound keeps running. Loads Neural Amp Modeler captures and can browse TONE3000 for them.
The same patch can be shown as a pedalboard with footswitches and rig slots. Knobs, switches and slots can be learned to MIDI. Patches are JSON files, and the last session comes back on launch.
Touch mode for handhelds: larger targets, tap an output and then an input to connect, hold for context menus, double tap to fit.

Bug fixes: recordings always saved, no crash on quit, MIDI note releases, looper overdub and undo, stereo bypass, recordings across sample-rate changes. New: a tone stack on the Neural Amp, a rebuilt 4-track, TONE3000 filters and auditioning.

A new app on GLFW and OpenGL: rack and pedalboard views, pedal groups, five rig slots, looper, recordings saved with the patch, MIDI learn, stereo modules, tuner, clock, TONE3000 browsing, gamepad control.

Undo/redo, Cabinet impulse-response node, File menu with recent files and portable project bundles (patch + models + IRs as a zip), context menus on modules, knobs, ports, cables and the canvas, and a much lighter rack UI.
First public release: 35 modules, Neural Amp Modeler support, rack UI with stomp bypass and live cables, guarded feedback, autosave recovery.
